title: Model Merging via Data-Free Covariance Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2604.01329v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Model merging provides a way of cheaply combining individual models to produce a model that inherits each individual's capabilities. While some merging methods can approach the performance of multitask training, they are often heuristically motivated and lack theoretical justification. A principled alternative is to pose model merging as a layer-wise optimization problem that directly minimizes interference between tasks. However, this formulation requires estimating per-layer covariance matrices from data, which may not be available when performing merging. In contrast, many of the heuristically-motivated methods do not require auxiliary data, making them practically advantageous. In this work, we revisit the interference minimization framework and show that, under certain conditions, covariance matrices can be estimated directly from difference matrices, eliminating the need for data while also reducing computational costs. translated_title: 基于无数据协方差估计的模型合并
translated_abstract: 模型合并提供了一种低成本地组合多个独立模型的方法，所得到的模型能够继承各个独立模型的能力。虽然某些合并方法可以达到接近多任务训练的性能，但这些方法往往只是启发式的，缺乏理论依据。一种更有原则的替代方案是将模型合并表述为一个逐层优化问题，直接最小化任务之间的干扰。然而，这种表述需要从数据中估计逐层的协方差矩阵，而在执行合并时这些数据可能并不可得。相比之下，许多启发式方法不需要辅助数据，因此在实践中更具优势。在本工作中，我们重新审视了干扰最小化框架，并证明在某些条件下，协方差矩阵可以直接从差异矩阵中估计得到，从而在无需数据的同时还降低了计算成本。我们验证……
tldr: 该论文提出无需任何数据即可直接从差异矩阵中估计协方差矩阵，从而在无数据条件下实现基于干扰最小化的模型合并，并降低了计算成本。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that, under certain conditions, covariance matrices for interference-minimization model merging can be estimated directly from difference matrices, eliminating the need for data while reducing computational costs.
